description: Context fence at eval scale: recall, then try to remember every recalled span with the receipt attached (must be rejected) and with a gno:// derivedFrom origin (must be rejected). Paraphrases of recalled spans carry neither marker; how many of them get through is reported, not asserted.

facts.text: Orbit's staging database is reset every Sunday night.
The Orbit SSO provider is Okta.
Orbit feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly.
Orbit error budgets are reviewed at the monthly ops meeting.
Orbit's public status page is hosted on Statuspage.
Orbit support tickets escalate to engineering after 48 hours.
